title: KK Viimsi win U19 League!
description: KK Viimsi have won U19 League in Estonia. They overcame Tartu Ulikool/Metec 87-84 in the Final game. Kristo Rannaste (191-SF-2007) stepped up with 25 points and 15 rebounds, whilst Christian Kask (187-G-2008) netted 21. Holger Suurorg (179-PG-2007) scored 16 points and Robin Berol) delivered 10 points for the winners. Vladyslav Sinnik (203-C-2007) replied with 23 points in the losing effort.
